cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Pre-register pattern, source cohort and target task. Measure later correct reuse, independent replication, human-time saved, false transfers and correction costs versus strong notebook.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Repeated phrasing, common model priors or graph densification masquerade as learning; abandon if no net independently verified benefit.
cards.nonclaim: Reusable text is not new causal law or evidence of self-evolution.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Reduce repeated investigation without suppressing unusual counterexamples.
cards.proposal: A reusable pattern that survives independent challenge may improve later hypothesis generation per unit of cost.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Versioned plain-text notebook with well-maintained recipes and citations.
cards.strongest_rival: Simple retrieval, templates, or ordinary accumulated experience yield equal improvements.
cards.title: CoPatternGain+

cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Replay forecast from a frozen cutoff; verify later corrected facts do not leak into earlier forecast. Require a separate user-reviewed definition before treating CoTume+ as a distinct primitive.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Any future-data leak, stale-time overwritten source or unauthorized alias promotion blocks adoption.
cards.nonclaim: A timestamp schema does not enable time travel, retrocausation or prophecy.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Retrospective and prospective consistency across different devices and observers.
cards.proposal: Every predictive relation should distinguish time observed, time valid, training cutoff, forecast issuance and target horizon; the uttered CoTume+ is preserved as an unresolved term alias, not silently redefined.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Simple historical ledger with ISO-8601 UTC timestamps, valid-time and observed-time fields.
cards.strongest_rival: Ordinary event-sourced timestamps, version control and standard temporal databases already suffice.
cards.title: CoTime+ / CoTume+ naming and bitemporal foresight

cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Score future-only Brier, log loss and decision regret at matched horizon and budget. Show uncertainty, sample size, target distribution shifts and negative cases.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Hold if real prospective gains are null, not reproducible, inaccessible or explained by leakage, multiple testing or trivial covariates.
cards.nonclaim: No genuine predictive superiority can be established from a synthetic fixture alone.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Earlier warning of uncertain outcomes without overstated confidence.
cards.proposal: Historical patterns may improve forecasts on some measurable tasks, with explicit horizons and calibrated uncertainty.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Prequential majority, last-value and uninformative 0.5 forecasts run on identical frozen synthetic and then independent real task windows.
cards.strongest_rival: An ordinary majority, last-observed or constant-rate baseline performs as well or better; nonstationary regimes destroy the effect.
cards.title: CoPrediction+ calibrated future tests

cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Inject a popular but false claim, duplicated model echoes and late contradictory evidence; test that no evidence/authority promotion occurs, that corrective signals reach readers, and that count-based reward cannot dominate.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: False consensus or hidden contradictions persist across projections, or popularity increases unsupported claim confidence.
cards.nonclaim: Reinforcement is not proof, causation, or divine guidance.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Learning from failures while preventing self-reinforcing error cascades.
cards.proposal: Every positive feedback edge should have a separately routed disconfirmation, dissent and stop/damp channel.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Append-only ledger with explicit success and failure entries, source weights, and negative controls.
cards.strongest_rival: Ordinary audits, holdout validation and contradiction registers achieve the same correction.
cards.title: CoFeedback+ and CoCounterPattern+

cards.discriminator_or_challenge: On pre-registered problems compare outcomes, failure modes, stakeholder impacts, choices preserved, calibration, cost and reversibility. Keep Pareto incomparability.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Prefer simpler baselines when no measured net benefit; suspend any proposal crossing rights/consent boundary.
cards.nonclaim: No claim that G_d exists as an agent, has wants, or authorizes action.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Future interests considered without treating speculative perspectives as instructions.
cards.proposal: A plural and revisable future-state portfolio can help identify neglected stakeholders and preserve optionality.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Equal-budget supply-only, demand-only, hybrid and shuffled selection rules with rights and consent gates.
cards.strongest_rival: A simple supply-demand hybrid can select equally beneficial, less costly options.
cards.title: CoG_dSide+ candidate futures and ethical evaluation

cards.discriminator_or_challenge: Freeze source-domain rule; use independent held-out target domain tasks, pre-registered mappings and independent evaluators. Score successful prediction, explanatory compression, failures and time cost.
cards.failure_or_stop_condition: Pattern predicts only in source domain, degrades target accuracy, or adds unnecessary ontology.
cards.nonclaim: Relations among analogies do not alone establish causality, identity or global prediction.
cards.potential_receiver_benefit: Legible reuse of learning without papering over domain-specific distinctions.
cards.proposal: A source-qualified pattern may transfer across domains only when mappings, invariants and known loss are explicit.
source_gaps: No independent prospective benchmark or external expert assessment
cards.strong_baseline: Domain-specific expert summaries and standard retrieval without a new universal pattern layer.
cards.strongest_rival: Apparent transfer is metaphor, correlated training data or a renamed existing method.
cards.title: CoTransfer+ cross-front pay-forward
